note: Authored claims. scripts/practice-baseline.mjs resolves every ref and demotes a claimed pass whose evidence is missing or whose suite did not run. Status vocabulary: passed | partial | not-run | blocked. A layer only proves its own scope: implementation presence is not usability, and a CI placeholder is never a hostProbe.
